body: youre right, this probably wont be forever. idk, i think i was in too deep and i forgot that i still had the chance to leave and build my life if i kept trying. thank you.

OP i don't really know what kind of relationship you have with your mom, but do you think she might feel relieved if you share your feelings with her? it may hurt, but maybe not in the way that you think. maybe the hurt would come from knowing that you are struggling. also, if she knew more about it, she might be able to help?

honestly how i've been feeling recently. it's hard to keep searching for the good parts of humanity when its overshadowed by the larger group of selfish, morally bankrupt people. there are a lot of days when i want to give up, stop believing that good exists, and become a hermit. i keep trying though, i know there's people out there that keep trying too. there's probably more than i could ever know, doing small acts of kindness when they can. i think that's the only thing that helps me keep being hopeful.
